question: Which freedom fighter was involved in the Kakori Train Action in 1925, for which the British government condemned him to death?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ram Prasad Bismil.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ram Prasad Bismil was the freedom fighter involved in the Kakori Train Action in 1925.**
 
• The Kakori Train Action was a planned robbery of a train carrying British government funds by a group of Indian revolutionaries.
 
• The British government condemned Ram Prasad Bismil to death for his involvement in the Kakori Train Action.
 
• Ram Prasad Bismil was also a** poet and writer** and played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lala Hardayal** was a revolutionary and a founder of the **Ghadar Party,** which aimed to overthrow British rule in India.
 
• **Vinayak Damodar Savarkar **was a pro-independence activist and a member of the Hindu nationalist organization, the** Hindu Mahasabha.**
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi was a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement and known for his non-violent resistance tactics.**
